Commentary.Commentary: For now, they have given away a 139-run lead which looks very big on this pitch. The African team will be confident at this stage and it might just reflect in their batting. Stay tuned for Zimbabwe's second innings. 8 more overs are left in the day's play.

Tendai Chatara and Kyle Jarvis were excellent up front and then Sikandar Raza also left his impact. They were very tidy in their approach and received good support from the pitch. Also, the shot selection from many Bangladeshi players was questionable and the head coach, Lalchand Rajput would have noticed that.
In the absence of Tamim Iqbal and Shakib Al Hasan, the fringe players failed to step up and deliver. Although, debutant Ariful Haque showed a lot of composure in his unbeaten knock of 41.

Bangladesh are blown away! Yes, you read it right. A team which troubled England and Australia in recent times has failed to withstand the bowling might of Zimbabwe. This has to be a new low for the Bangla Tigers. They are a team to reckon with at home but this hapless batting show has risen many questions.

OUT! Run out! Abu Jayed was told to be ready for a run but he needed to watch the ball also. It's flicked straight into the hands of mid-wicket and Jayed blindly comes out of the crease in search of a run. The fielder lobs up the ball to the bowler who takes the bails off immediately. Ariful is unhappy. BANGLADESH ALL OUT FOR 143!
On a length and outside off, pushed from the crease to covers again. Ariful walks up to his partner and has a chat. Maybe, telling him to be ready for a single.
Presses forward to a length delivery and drives it to the cover fielder.
Good length ball on off, angling in, Haque works once again on the leg side, it's in the gap at mid-wicket but no run taken.
Fuller and straighter, flicked in front of square leg and denied the single.
Good length delivery landing around off and shaping back in, Ariful blocks it off his back foot.
Floated off spinner landing full around off, Abu lunges and defends it watchfully.
Abu Jayed is the last batsman for Bangladesh.

OUT! Raza gets his third! He dishes out an off spinner on middle and it curls away just a bit after landing. Nazmul strides forward to defend but it takes the outside half of the bat and goes straight into the hands of Brian Chari at silly point. Sharp reflexes, that! Zimbabwe continue to roar.
Full and on off, defended off the front foot.
Slider, around off, skidding in, Nazmul goes on the back foot in defense.
Off spinner on middle, whipped with the spin to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and shorter around off, Ariful goes back in defense.
Fuller and on middle, driven back past the bowler but the mid on fielder quickly got to the ball.
A length delivery on middle and off, Nazmul keeps his eyes on the ball and defends it to the off side.

Goes for the yorker but it turns out to be an overpitched delivery on middle. Ariful clips it through mid-wicket and wants the second run. But seeing the fielder quickly getting to the ball, they decide against it.
Once again targets the off stump line with a fuller length delivery. Haque does well to push it out towards mid on again.
Full and around off, angling in again, Ariful gets on the front foot and defends it off the inner half of the bat to mid on.
Good length delivery angling into the batsman, Ariful presses forward and pushes it back to the bowler.
Full and fired in on middle, blocked soundly back to the bowler.
Tossed up ball outside off, turning away slightly, Nazmul strides his front leg forward and then makes the leave.
Tossed up ball on off, Islam defends it off his front foot.
Quicker, flatter and shorter. Landing close to off and Nazmul cuts it off his back foot to point.
FOUR! Up and over! Good calculative risk taken by Nazmul. He receives the fuller length delivery around off with open arms and just lifts it over mid off for a boundary.
Allows the ball to turn back in and since the length is on the shorter side, Ariful easily pushes it down to long on for a single.
Fullish and angling away from the southpaw, Islam drives square of the wicket but only to find the point fielder.
Full and on the pads, blocked in the direction of mid on.
Good length delivery on middle and off, Nazmul covers the line and defends it to the off side.
Fullish and on middle, Haque pushes it down the ground with good timing and rushes across to the other end as the mid on fielder cuts it off.

FOUR! Shot! Chatara dishes out a short delivery outside off, angling in a shade, Ariful stays back and executes his square cut in the gap. The sweeper fielder tries his best to pull it back but to no avail.
Cutting back into the batsman from a length outside off. Ariful fails to work it on the leg side and is hit on the back leg. A stifled appeal by the bowler but it's too high.
Fuller and on off, Nazmul defends it ahead of his front pad. 2 runs and a wicket from the over.
Slower delivery, full and on middle, it's worked on the leg side.
Nazmul Islam is the new batsman.

OUT! An absolute beauty by Sikandar to send Taijul packing. Drifting into the batsman, it lands around middle and off before turning away from Taijul. He tries to play the trajectory but the ball spin away to take a faint outside edge. Regis Chakabva makes no mistake, they appeal and the finger goes up. Raza gets his second wicket and is running in joy. Bangladesh trail by 151 runs.
Quicker one, short in length, cut from the back foot but straight to point.
Nicely tossed up delivery, it's full and on off, drifting in, Taijul presses forward in defense.
Short in length on off, from 'round the wicket, Taijul moves back and plays a late cut wide of backward point. A couple taken.
Lands it on a length around off, shaping back in, Ariful stays back and defends it to the leg side.
A gentle delivery, in the zone outside off, Ariful strides forward and pushes it through covers for a couple.
Bowls it full and on the pads, it's been clipped through square leg for a run.
Angling away from the batsman, on a good length again, Taijul plays at it from the crease and keeps it out safely.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, Ariful reaches out for it with an angled bat and pushes it through covers for a run.
Shout for an lbw! Chatara angles in a length ball on middle and gets it to move down. Haque fails to flick and is hit on the pads. They put in an unsuccessful appeal. Missing leg in all likelihood.
Tendai Chatara is back on. He was deadly in his first spell, his figures read, 6-3-9-3!
Fullish and on middle, defended back to end the over.
Loopy and on off, Taijul is on the front foot as he defends it with gentle hands.
Too full and on middle, pushed back to the bowler off the front foot.
Floated one, landing full around off, Islam gets on the front foot in defense.
Flighted ball on middle, Ariful walks forward and forces it down to long on for a run.
Flatter on off, defended off the back foot.
Drinks! Zimbabwe continue to be on top by picking two more wickets in the last hour. Bangladesh struggling big time and that's not happened too often to them of late at home.
Loopy ball on off, Islam is solid in defense.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Similar ball, turned to the man to the leg side.
Full down leg, flicked to square leg. Dot ball.
Short ball outside off, cut to the man at point.
AH flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
Short ball on off, punched on his back foot to the off side for a run.
Pushed to the cover region by Haque. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.

NOT OUT! Good running in the end. Short ball over the stumps, Islam cuts it late towards third man. They come back for the third run. The throw is at the keeper's end. Rahim takes of the bails but Ariful is in. The replays confirm the same.
A run out appeal is taken up. Looks safe.
Punched off the back foot towards covers for a single.
Leg spinner on off, Ariful uses his feet and hits it back to the bowler.
Driven to the covers by the batsman.
Sikandar Raza is called onto bowl.
Islam stays back and pushes it to the off side.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman.
On middle and leg, turned to the on side.
Driven through the covers by AH. They pick up a single.
Gets behind the ball and blocks it in front of him.

Tendai Chatara is trying his best to catch his skipper's attention. He has not been given the ball at all in this session. The reason is best known to Hamilton Masakadza. With just three more wickets left, Chatara would love to get the ball in his hand and claim his second fifer in Tests.
Quicker ball around off, played into the ground.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Haque transfers his weight onto his back foot and punches this ball through covers. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Pressure releasing shot! Lofts this tossed up ball over mid off for a one-bounce boundary.
Darts this on the leg side, Haque gets it off his pads to the short leg fielder.
Taijul flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Floated ball on off, Islam presents the full face of the bat.
Arm ball on leg, turned away to the mid-wicket region. End of a successful over.
Haque covers his stumps and pushes this ball to the on side.
Islam flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Leans ahead and plays this to the off side.
Taijul Islam is in to bat.

OUT! A stubborn stand is broken! As things were looking to settle down, Sean Williams strikes gold. Fires this on the leg side. Hasan looks to turn it away but closes the bat face early. The ball takes a leading edge and flies towards Williams who takes the catch over his head. He smiles and has a surprised look on his face. Mehidy, meanwhile, is very hesitant in walking back to the pavilion, not sure why... Anyway, Bangladesh still trail by 174 and are 7 wickets down.
Hasan gets behind the ball and sees it out.
Loopy ball on leg, Haque plays it into the ground.
Enough time for Hasan to rock back and punch this to extra cover for one.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Loopy ball on middle and off, bunted down.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Covers his stumps and hits this to the off side.
Flatter on off, Hasan blocks it out.
Short ball down leg, Hasan helps it on its way towards fine leg for a couple of runs.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Quicker one in line, Hasan defends it with a straight bat.
Outside off, played to the off side.
Flatter on off, played in front of the bowler.
Sean Williams to bowl his first over.
Arm ball which skids away down leg, Haque leaves it alone.
Comes forward and bunts this down on the ground.
A repeat of the previous ball.
Loopy ball in line of the stumps, Haque stonewalls it.
Driven through the covers by Hasan. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Comes forward and blocks it out to the off side.
Driven towards the mid off region.
FOUR! Short ball on leg, Ariful goes back and pulls it through square leg. The fielder in the deep hares to his left but to no avail.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
On a good length around off, Haque plays it to the off side.
Length on off, Haque defends this off his off his back foot.
Length ball outside off, Haque looks to cut it but gets a bottom edge towards the slip cordon.
FOUR! Sees the ball floated up, uses his feet and lofts it over mid off for a boundary.
Goes back again and punches it but straight to the man at mid off.
Haque rocks back and punches this to the off side for one.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Comes forward and blocks it out.
Outside off, kept out.
Length, coming into Hasan who hits it back to the bowler.
Mehidy gets behind this ball and taps it out.
Another good shot. Fuller in line, flicked away by Hasan through mid-wicket for a brace.
On a good length on off, Hasan defends it.
Outside off, cut past point. They manage to come back for the second.
Length ball on middle, Hasan plays it with a straight bat.
Pushed to the cover region by Hasan. They pick up a single.
Full and on off, driven to mid off.
That ball has taken the inside edge onto the pads.
Short ball outside off, Haque rocks back and punches the ball to extra cover. There is protection which keeps it to one.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Straighter one on off, Haque blocks it out.
Length down leg, flicked away towards deep square leg for one.
Length on middle and leg, Ariful gets it off the inner half towards short mid-wicket.
Reverse swing from around off, it comes back in and Ariful punches it to covers.
Good length ball outside off, Ariful watches it go outside his off stump.
Length a bit outside off, tapped to the off side.
Length around off, Haque plays it with a straight bat.
FOUR! Short ball asking to be hit, Hasan pulls it through mid-wicket for another boundary. That nearly went to Chatara at mid-wicket. It was hit hard which saved Mehidy.
On off, driven to covers.
Pushed to the cover region by Mehidy.
Pushes this to the off side.
Loopy ball on off, Hasan is forward in defense. The ball goes uppishly towards the vacant silly point region. Had there been one, that could have been a catch.
Flatter on off, cut past point for one.
Wellington Masakadza to bowl from the other end.
Length around off, kept out.
FOUR! Takes the aerial route and gets a boundary! Dishes this full ball down leg, Hasan flicks it over mid-wicket. The ball races to the boundary.
Similar line and length this time played to mid on.
In search of swing lands it on middle and leg, Hasan turns it to the on side.
Mehidy Hasan is the new man in.

OUT! A wicket next ball! Rahim is out of here! This is exactly what Zimbabwe wanted and Jarvis strikes. Similar length closer to the stumps, shoots up a bit. Rahim looks to push at it, is caught at the crease and the ball hits the shoulder of the bat before going to the keeper who takes a simple catch. Delight for the visitors and Rahim has to walk back with Bangladesh reeling.
FOUR! What a start for the hosts! Jarvis comes in from over the wicket and lands this on a good length outside off, Rahim cuts it late through backward point for a boundary.

We're back. The men concerned are back on the field as well. 33 overs left in the day's play. Can Zimbabwe end on a high? Or will be see the hosts bounce back? We'll find out soon. Kyle Jarvis has the ball. A slip and a gully in place along with two catchers on the off and on sides. Let's play...
... DAY 2, 3RD SESSION ...

The pitch offered good assistance to the bowlers in the afternoon but to be honest, most of the wickets fell due to the reckless nature of the shots attempted. The hosts will be disappointed currently and need their lower half to give Rahim good support. Join us in a short while for the evening session.

Five wickets in the session and Zimbabwe are right on top in this Test match! Tendai Chatara was the best bowler on show as he got the ball to move both ways. He claimed three wickets while Kyle Jarvis and Sikandar Raza picked one wicket apiece. Bangladesh find themselves on the back foot, trailing by 208 runs and need their experienced campaigner, Mushfiqur Rahim to step up. The visitors have already given Rahim one life when his stumping chance was missed and they would hope that won't come back to haunt them.
Flighted and on off, Ariful presses forward in defense. Tea on Day 2!
Fuller and on off, driven back to the bowler.

Bounced in front! A tossed up ball on off, Ariful tries to defend off the front foot but it spins away a bit to kiss the outside edge of his bat. It's dying in front of Hamilton who goes down to attempt for the catch. Ain't too sure whether that carried and the umpires go upstairs. Soft signal was not out. The replays roll in and they show that it bounced in front of the fielder.

Edged but has that carried? Hamilton Masakadza goes down low at first slip to take the catch but he is not looking too sure. The two umpires get together and then go upstairs. The soft signal is not out.
Gets behind the line to cover the spin and then defends it on the leg side.
Very full in length on off, driven firmly down the ground but straight to mid off.
Gets on the front foot to a full ball and pushes it back to the bowler.
Short and around off, Rahim cuts it from the crease but finds point.
Remains on the back foot and keeps it out safely on the off side.
Short in length and outside off, staying low, Rahim lets it be and the keeper struggles while collecting the ball.
Advances down the track to a full ball and eases it down to long on for a run.
Allows the ball to spin back in and then plays it with an angled bat to backward point. A single taken.
Tossed up ball on off, Rahim goes back and then offers a straight bat in defense.
Leans forward to a full ball and defends it on the leg side.
Fuller and outside off, driven to covers.
Rocks back to a short ball and punches it to covers.
Flighted around off, Ariful tries to play from the back foot but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Flatter and shorter on off, punched to covers.
Starts with a fuller length ball on off, Ariful defends it by getting forward.
Wellington Masakadza is introduced into the attack.
Loopy full ball on off, Rahim presents a straight bat in defense.
FOUR! Cracking shot! This time it's a full toss around off, Rahim attacks it with all his power and drills it through extra cover for a boundary.
Once again Rahim presses forward as he defends it softly to short leg.
Tossed up ball on off, Rahim lunges and defends it with soft hands to short leg.
Flighted and full on off, driven towards mid off for a quick run.
Allows the ball to spin back in and defends it in front of short leg.
Once again prefers to stay back inside the crease as he blocks it out on the off side.
Flatter ball on off, Rahim defends it off his back foot.
Rahim has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. They pick up a single.

Shout for a run out! A delivery landing on middle and leg, Rahim fails to work it away and it goes off his pads towards square leg. They attempt a leg bye as Chakabva runs after the ball. He picks up and scores a direct hit at his end but no harm done.
Full and outside off, drive through the line and it hit the silly point fielder.
Stays back footed again and defends it down safely.
Flat again, short and on middle, defended from the crease.
Flatter and shorter on off, Ariful defends it off his back foot.
Tossed up ball on off, Ariful dances down the track and pushes it back to the bowler. Raza picks up the ball and has an immediate shy at the striker's end.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Shortish and on off, Ariful plays it down from the crease to point.
FOUR! Superbly played! Too full in length on off and Rahim gives this one the desired treatment. Goes down on one knee and powers it to the deep mid-wicket fence.
A cracking drive this time, with the spin Ariful goes and finds the gap at covers. A single taken.
Probably a googly this time. It's full and around off, Haque defends it off his front foot.
Stands back inside the crease to a short ball and punches it to covers.
Whoa! Mavuta gives this one some extra rip and lands it short around middle. Ariful lets it be and it spins away big to go outside off.
Tossed up ball on off, Ariful defends it with soft hands to the off side.
Loopy full on off, Rahim is on the front foot as he defends it back to the bowler.
Another back foot defense by Rahim.
Flatter on off, defended off the back foot.

Stumping chance missed! A big moment in the match, this! Raza serves an off spinner outside off and Rahim tries to walk into his attempted flick shot. But he fails to put bat on ball as it curls back in. Chakabva too fails to collect the ball and Rahim gets a life. The ball has travelled behind for FOUR BYES!
Too full in length and wide outside off, Rahim reaches out for it and squeezes it out to covers.
Spinning in from outside off, Rahim stays back and pushes it out on the off side.
Gets on the front foot and offers a straight bat in defense.
Ariful has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Drops it short outside off and Rahim punches it to sweeper cover for one.

Shout for an lbw! Mavuta delivers a leg spinner outside off to which Rahim offers no shot. He wears it on his pads and they let out a big appeal. Impact can't be a question here but the line is already wide and the ball is spinning away. Would have easily missed the stumps.

Uppish and it's just wide of short cover! Full and flighted on off, turning away, Ariful plays the drive, fails to keep it down and is lucky that it's not gone straight into the fielder's hands. They pick up a single.
Turning away from the batsman, the length is on the shorter side and Rahim cuts it past cover-point for a run.
This is beautifully played. Ariful strides forward to a full ball and drives it nicely past the right side of the mid off fielder. The mid on fielder chases it down and they take a couple.
Shortish and on off, punched off the back foot to covers.

Inside edge... Raza gets this one to spin back in from around off, Ariful tries to defend it with a straight bat but it takes the inside edge and rolls to fine leg for two. Not a convincing way to kick-start your Test career. 50 up for Bangladesh.
Debutant Ariful Haque walks in next.

OUT! Massive blow to Bangladesh! Mominul is gone and now the home team has lost half their side with their score not even 50. A lovely off spinner dished out by Raza. He puts it just around off and Mominul is drawn forward in defense. But he doesn't account for the away spin much and as a result gets a nick behind. Hamilton Masakadza makes no mistake at first slip and Sikandar is running in celebration.
Loopy delivery outside off, Mominul strides forward and then lets it go to the keeper.
Too full and on off, driven to short cover.
Shorter length delivery outside off, some extra bounce there, Rahim goes back to cut it to deep point for a brace.
Full and on middle, helped off the pads on the leg side to mid-wicket for one.
Tossed up ball on middle, defended back.
FOUR! Fine shot! Tossed up ball on middle, Mominul goes down on one knee and sweeps it through square leg for a boundary. Did well to keep it all along the ground.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. They pick up a single.
Loopy and full on off, Rahim strides forward in defense.
Turning into the batsman from around middle, Rahim works it off his pads to square leg for a run.
Short in length and outside off, Rahim cuts it off his back foot but finds point.
Once again a similar attempt by Mominul, this time he gets it away with a drive to mid off for a run.

Nearly a return catch! Tossed up ball on middle and off, Haque walks forward with the intention to drive through the line. Fails to middle his shot properly and chips it back. Luckily for him, it doesn't carry back to Raza.
Full floated ball on off, Mominul defends it by getting forward.
Flighted and full ball on off, flicked on the leg side but straight to mid-wicket.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
On middle and leg, MR gets a soft leading edge to point.
Loopy leg spinner outside off, Rahim leaves it alone.
Leg spinner on off, punched to extra cover for a brace.
Haque flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Leg spinner on off, played with a straight bat.
FOUR! That's short and Rahim makes full use of it. Rocks back and then pulls this through square leg for a boundary. Two boundaries in two overs for the hosts.
Played to the mid-wicket region by Haque. One run added to the total.
Rahim works this towards square leg for a single.
Rahim gets behind the ball and stonewalls it.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Outside off, pushed to the off side.
Sikandar Raza to roll his arm.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. They have run through for a single.
Yes-no! Bangladesh survive! Plays this with soft hands towards point. A yes-no situation and no run taken in the end.
FOUR! Full toss outside off, Rahim drives it through covers for a boundary. There to be hit and Rahim capitalizes on it.
Lovely tossed up ball outside off, draws Haque forward. Almost gets his outside edge. The keeper fails to make contact and the batsmen pick up 3 bye runs.
Leg spinner on off, tapped to the off side.
Short ball down leg, Haque pulls it fine to fine leg. They pick up a couple of runs.
Brandon Mavuta is the first change.
Nice line on middle and leg, Rahim plays it with a straight bat.
Length ball outside off, no movement through the air. Rahim shoulders his arms.
On middle and leg, turned to square leg. Dot ball.
On off, punched to mid off.
Lands this further on middle and leg, Rahim hits this to short mid-wicket.
Length ball on middle and leg, Rahim gets it off the inner half towards mid-wicket.

Drinks break! What an hour of play for the visitors! Both their pacers have shared the spoil and put Bangladesh on the back foot. Rahim and Haque are very much capable of steering the ship back to safety though.
Outside off, left alone.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Slightly overpitched outside off, driven to mid off.
On middle and leg, bunted down to the on side.
Full and outside off, invites Haque for the drive. Not the best of timings as the ball rolls towards short covers.
Length ball around off, Haque plays it towards mid on.

Play and a miss! That's a very ordinary shot selection from the most experienced batsman in Bangladesh's batting line-up. Jarvis bowls it short and wide outside off, Rahim throws his bat at it in an attempt to flat-bat it through point but fails to connect.
Hurls a length delivery in the channel outside off, it holds its line after pitching and Rahim lets it through after closely watching the line.
Once again on a length and in the off stump line, Rahim stays back to defend it on the off side.
Nicely bowled. Lands it on a length around off and gets it to angle back into the right-hander. Rahim is behind the line as he blocks it with a dead straight bat.
Digs in a short ball on middle and off, Mominul stays back and pulls it across the line. Not much timing as it rolls through backward square leg for a run.
A length ball angling across the left-handed batsman, Mominul gets forward to cover the line and then shoulders arms.
Rahim defends this from within his crease. Two wickets from the over, Chatara oozing class!
Mushfiqur Rahim walks out next to bat.

OUT! Another one bites the dusts! Oh my God! What are Bangladesh doing? Credit to Zimbabwe though. Chatara bowls this outside off, Mahmudullah feels for it away from his body as he has a tame push at it. Gets a big inside edge onto the off pole. Poor from someone like Mahmudullah to attempt such type of a shot early on. Zimbabwe on top!
Mahmudullah shoulders arms to let that one through.
Mahmudullah is the new man in.

OUT! What a review from Masakadza! He was put under pressure from his players and a wise decision in the end. This was full and outside off, Nazmul drives without much footwork and fails to middle his shot. It flies behind and the keeper catches it. There seems to be some noise when it went through to Chakabva. The bowler was not quite sure but the men behind the stumps put in an appeal. The umpire stays put. Hamilton takes it up and the replay shows us a big spike. Shanto is out of here and Bangladesh lose their third wicket. Perhaps, the dog distracted the concentration of Shanto.
Appeal for a caught behind. Not given. It's been referred by Zimbabwe.
Play interrupted! A stray dog strolls out on the field and disturbs the play.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

FOUR! DROPPED? Tough chance! Length ball just outside off, Shanto is tentative is his drive. Gets an outside edge which flies in between Taylor and Masakadza, also a bit ahead of them at the slips. The ball races away to the third man fence.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Off drives this towards mid off and gets to the other end. Wellington hits the stumps at the non-striker's end but the batsman is well in.
Welcomes Shanto with a bouncer. He ducks under it.
Nazmul Hossain Shanto is the new man in.

OUT! Another wicket falls! Kyle Jarvis gets his man and some good bowling is rewarded. Length ball outside off, it moves away after pitching. Das plays away from his body and gets an outside edge towards the keeper. Chakabva goes to his right and takes a good catch. The umpire checks for the no ball but it is all fine.
Driven through mid on by the batsman.
FOUR! Beautiful! Length ball outside off, Liton waits for the ball and plays it under his eyes, in the gap through covers for a glorious boundary.
Nice looking shot and well fielded. Overpitched outside off, Haque drives but the man at short cover dives and stops the run.
Rocks back and punches this to mid off. Dot ball.
On middle and off, defended from within the crease.
Lands this closer to the stumps, Haque taps it to the off side.
Angles this across the left-hander, Haque does the right thing by leaving it alone.
Full and outside off, no timing on that one as Haque drives it to mid off.
Length and outside off, Das cannot find the gap as he punches this to covers.
Length ball around off, Das is solid in his defense.
Outside off, played with soft hands towards point.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Length ball a bit outside off, Das punches it off his back foot towards covers. Mavuta dives but cannot stop the ball. The batsmen pick up a couple of runs.
Length ball over the stumps, Das taps this to cover-point. Nice line and length from both the pacers so far.
Outside off, Haque watches the ball go through to the keeper.
Back of a length ball on the leg side. Haque looks to play this with a straight bat but gets a soft leading edge to the off side. Chatara is causing a few problems here. Good stuff from him.
Angles this away from Haque who plays it with a straight bat near the pitch.
Short ball outside off, Haque sways away from it.
Outside off, left alone.
It's been driven superbly through the covers but for nothing.
Goes full again on leg, turned  to the man at mid-wicket.
A bit full on off, Das covers his stumps and presents a full bat face.
Nice ball. Full and on middle and leg, almost a yorker. Das digs it out in time.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Length around off, played with a straight bat.
Played to mid-wicket region by Das.
Full and outside off, moves away, Haque leaves it alone. Successful over.
Mominul Haque is in at no.3.

OUT! Bowled 'em! There it is! Chatara has got his man. Nicely sets him up. Bowls this on a back of a length ball around off. Kayes doesn't play it with a straight bat. Looks to block it down from the crease but ends up chopping it back onto his stumps. Early breakthrough for Zimbabwe and some smart bowling from Tendai. Big wicket for Zimbabwe as Kayes was in outstanding form in the ODIs.
The ball is too wide on the off side for Imrul to make any contact.
Kayes shoulders arms to let that one through.
Better length from Chatara. Bowls this on a good length on off, it pitches and moves away from the batsman who is tentative in his defense.
Das has flicked the ball off his pads. They pick up a single.
Length on off, punched off the back foot to the off side.
Darts this on middle and leg, Das clips it towards mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Another further up ball on off, Das drives it to mid off.
Good ball, this is the perfect line on middle. In search of swing. Das drives it to mid on.
Again outside off, too far to make Das play at it.
Outside off, easy leave for the batsman.
Back of a length ball outside off, Kayes blocks it out.
Shows the full face of the bat and IK defends this from.
FOUR! Educated edge. Outside off this, Kayes angles it slightly towards third man for a boundary.
Outside off, cut to the fielder at point.
Length on off, Kayes defends this off his back foot.
Full and angles this away from Kayes who goes for the booming drive first up. Fails to put bat to it.

Back for the afternoon session! The players are making their way out in the middle. Zimbabwe are opting for the pace of Tendai Chatara from the other end. No experimentation with a spinner with the new ball.
... DAY 2, 2ND SESSION ...

For the visitors, they will like to make early inroads and then put pressure on the hosts. They have a formidable pair of pacers and Kyle Jarvis did get the ball to move in the over before the break. Hopefully, we get some good cricketing action. Join us for the post Lunch session at 1240 local (0640 GMT)

Just the one over then before the Lunch break. Bangladesh will be the happier side as they picked up the remaining wickets in the first session and are now heading into the break unscratched. They would look to see out this early phase against the new ball and then build as many partnerships as possible.
Back of a length ball on off, Das defends it off his back foot. That will be LUNCH on Day 2.
Length ball outside off, Das shoulders his arms.
Angles this into the pads of the batsman, Kayes flicks it through mid-wicket to get off the mark.
Length on that fourth stump line, Kayes plays it in front of him with a straight bat.
Errs this down leg, Das flicks it through square leg for the first runs for his side.
Comes in from over the wicket and lands it outside off, Das leaves it alone.
